summary: IEEE-library form of three-position selector returning from right: this three-position selector returns from its right position according to its mechanism.
description: This reference locates three-position selector returning from right in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 position selector switches family. This three-position selector returns from its right position according to its mechanism. The mode or command schedule needs to state which positions are momentary and which are retained. The public library uses HSS113R for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Trace the right-hand command after the operator releases the handle. The printed right position depends on the defined front view of the operator. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
